rows.Origin:
Bred by Mike Athy (New Zealand, before 2002).
Introduced in New Zealand by D&S Nurseries as 'Rebecca Susan'.
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses as '7 de laan'.
Introduced in Canada by Hortico Inc. in 2006 as 'Rebecca Susan'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink, tan shading. Beige. Mild to strong, musk fragrance. Small to medium, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: disease resistant, susceptible to blackspot .
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
